title: Parcels the shape classifier is least sure of

meta.publisher: City of Vancouver Open Data Portal
meta.local_areas_from: local-area-boundary (City of Vancouver Open Data Portal), point in polygon on the parcel's geo_point_2d; the parcel records carry no geo_local_area field
meta.licence: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Vancouver (property parcel polygons; local area boundary).

how_chosen: Parcels where some of the nudged re-runs (thresholds moved a little; the simplification's 3 degree / 0.5 m tolerances halved and doubled) disagree with the call, lowest agreement first and then nearest a threshold, at most six per pair of classes so the set covers every boundary; multi_part is never uncertain and is left out.
how_to_label: Set label to one of rectangle, near_rectangle, trapezoid, l_shape, flag_lot, irregular, multi_part (or 'other: ...'), and labels_by to your initials and the date.
